author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/47-trust-model.md — REQ-5 + decomposition PR 6.

## Surface
- New frontend module: `polaris-frontend/src/admin/trust_policy/`
- New route: `/admin/upstream-labelers/{id}/trust-policy`
- Editor renders:
  - Flat weight slider
  - Per-category table with add/remove rows
  - Per-subject-class table
  - Time decay (half-life days input)
- Preview pane shows: "with this policy, the last 50 observations from this source would have weights: …" (list of observations with computed weights, fetched from a new `GET /api/admin/upstream-labelers/{id}/preview-weights?policy=<json>` endpoint).

## Rust-quality notes
- **The preview endpoint is read-only** — it takes a policy as a query param (URL-encoded JSON) and computes weights against the last N observations WITHOUT saving. Per rust-quality §3: deliberately separate from the save endpoint to avoid surprise side effects.
- Frontend component is Leptos following the existing admin patterns (verify in-repo for admin precedent — if none, this PR establishes the pattern).
- Per rust-quality §6: the preview computation runs on the BACKEND (the trust function lives in `polaris-trust` which is workspace-shared and could compile to wasm, but the data is server-side).
- CSS following the BEM patterns from #97 NetworkPanel: `.trust-policy-editor__*`. Verify `styles_coverage` test passes for the new classes.

## External references
- existing admin frontend patterns: `polaris-frontend/src/admin/` (if exists)
- Leptos forms: https://book.leptos.dev/view/03_components.html

## Acceptance (REQ-5)
- [ ] Editor renders all four policy components (flat, per-category, per-subject-class, time-decay).
- [ ] Editing a value triggers a debounced preview fetch (200ms) and renders the updated weight list.
- [ ] Save button is disabled until the policy passes client-side validation.
- [ ] `styles_coverage` test passes for the new BEM classes.

## Blocks / blocked-by
- Blocked by #148.
- Blocks #150 (explain command + case-view visibility complete the audit-loop UX).
